Million Manhoef is a Dutch professional footballer born on October 31, 2001, in Rotterdam, Netherlands. He primarily plays as a right winger or right wing-back.

**Career:**

- **Youth/Early Career:** He came through the youth academy of Vitesse Arnhem in the Netherlands.

- **Vitesse:** He made his senior debut for Vitesse and developed into a regular first-team player in the Eredivisie. He gained attention for his pace, directness, and attacking ability down the right flank.

- **Stoke City:** In January/February 2024, Manhoef transferred to Stoke City in the English Championship, signing a multi-year contract. The move was seen as one of the more exciting signings for Stoke during that window, given his potential and pace.

**Background:**
He is of Surinamese descent, which is common among many Dutch footballers. He has represented the Netherlands at youth international levels.

**Playing Style:**
Manhoef is known for being a quick, athletic, and direct attacking player. He's comfortable taking on defenders one-on-one and contributing to attacks with crosses and shots. He has also been deployed as an attacking full-back/wing-back, taking advantage of his stamina and forward runs.
